# Jeremiah 21 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** The-word which came to Jeremiah from-YHWH, when King Zedekiah sent to-him Pashhur son-of Malchijah and-Zephaniah son-of Maaseiah the-priest, saying,

**2** "Inquire, please, of-YHWH on-our-behalf, for Nebuchadnezzar king-of Babylon is-making-war against-us; perhaps YHWH will-deal with-us according-to-all His-wonders, and-he-will-go-up from-upon-us."

**3** And-Jeremiah said to-them, "Thus you-shall-say to Zedekiah:

**4** Thus says YHWH God-of Israel: 'Behold-Me turning-back the-weapons-of war which [are] in-your-hand, with-which you fight against the-king-of Babylon and-the-Chaldeans who-besiege you, from-outside the-walls, and-I-will-gather-them into-the-midst-of this city.

**5** And-I Myself will-fight against-you with-an-outstretched hand and-with-a-strong arm, and-in-anger and-in-fury and-in-great wrath.

**6** And-I-will-strike the-inhabitants-of this city, both-man and-beast; with-a-great pestilence they-will-die.

**7** And-afterward,' declares YHWH, 'I-will-give Zedekiah king-of Judah and-his-servants and-the-people and-those-remaining in this city from the-pestilence, from the-sword, and-from the-famine, into-the-hand-of Nebuchadnezzar king-of Babylon and-into-the-hand-of their-enemies and-into-the-hand-of those-seeking their-life, and-he-will-strike-them with-the-edge-of the-sword; he-will-not-spare-them and-will-not-have-pity and-will-not-have-compassion.'

**8** And-to this people you-shall-say, 'Thus says YHWH: Behold-Me setting before-you the-way-of life and-the-way-of death.

**9** The-one-sitting in this city will-die by-the-sword and-by-the-famine and-by-the-pestilence; but-the-one-going-out and-falling-away to the-Chaldeans who-besiege you, he-will-live and-his-life will-be to-him as-plunder.

**10** For I-have-set My-face against this city for-evil and-not for-good,' declares YHWH; 'into-the-hand-of the-king-of Babylon it-will-be-given, and-he-will-burn-it with-fire.'"

**11** And-to-the-house-of [the]-king-of Judah: Hear [the]-word-of YHWH,

**12** O-house-of David, thus says YHWH: "Judge with-justice in-the-morning, and-deliver [the]-robbed from-[the]-hand-of [the]-oppressor, lest My-fury go-forth like-fire and-burn and-none can-extinguish-[it], because-of the-evil-of your-deeds.

**13** Behold-Me against-you, [O]-inhabitant-of the-valley, rock-of the-plain," declares YHWH, "[you]-who-say, 'Who will-come-down against-us? And-who will-enter into-our-dwellings?'

**14** And-I-will-punish-you according-to-the-fruit-of your-deeds," declares YHWH, "and-I-will-kindle a-fire in-her-forest, and-it-will-devour everything around-her."

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **21:2**: Nebuchadnezzar (Nevu-kadnetzzar) — the Babylonian king's name appears in its Hebrew form. Zedekiah hopes for divine intervention similar to the Assyrian retreat in Hezekiah's time (2 Kgs 19:35).

- **21:8**: Derekh ha-chayyim ve-derekh ha-mavet — 'the way of life and the way of death.' Echoes the Deuteronomic choice formula (Deut 30:15-19). Here, paradoxically, 'life' means surrender.

- **21:13**: Yoshevet ha-emeq — 'inhabitant of the valley.' Jerusalem's false confidence in its topographic defenses mirrors its false theological confidence.

— EMET
